newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NSW TAB worth up to A$1.4 bln - Macquarie.
newsitem.headline: NSW TAB worth up to A$1.4 bln - Macquarie.

text.p: The New South Wales State Government's betting agency, the Totalisator Agency Board (TAB), which it expects to float later this year, can be valued at between A$1.25 billion to A$1.4 billion, Macquarie Bank said.

"With margins of 30 percent and huge growth potential through expanded product distribution and new gaming product, this represents a significant opportunity for investors," Macquarie Equities tourism and leisure analyst Jennifer Owen said in a report.
Owen said the valuation was a conservative one of a wagering business seen as the largest and most profitable in Australia.
There was growth potential in the linked jackpot market for TAB Ltd, with access to the second largest gaming machine market in the world, she said.
"Forecast margins for this type of business, both in Australia and the United States, are around 50 percent of net machine revenue," she said.
A lowering of the New South Wales tax on wagering to a level equivalent to that on other forms of gambling in New South Wales would increase returns to the New South Wales racing industry, she said.
